name: figma-linux-next
description: Unofficial Electron-based browser wrapper for the Figma web app on Linux. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Figma, Inc.
author: Figma Linux Community

scripts.start: bun run build && bun run run
scripts.build: bun run cln && vite build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/package.json','dist/package.json')" && cd dist && bun install --production --no-save
scripts.pack: rm -rf build/installers && bun run build && chmod a+x ./resources/AppRun && bun run builder
scripts.package: rm -rf build/installers && bun run build && electron-builder --config=config/builder.json -l
scripts.local:install: sudo rm -rf /opt/figma-linux-next && sudo mkdir -p /opt/figma-linux-next && sudo cp -rf ./build/installers/linux-unpacked/* /opt/figma-linux-next/
scripts.//: bun test (combined) conflicts with e2e due to electron preload - use test:unit && test:e2e separately
